body: While reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models, its efficacy in long-horizon multimodal tasks remains underexplored. Visual Sudoku puzzles pose a representative challenge, requiring multi-step deductive reasoning over both local constraints and global dependency chains. To this end, we introduce FG-Sudoku, a fine-grained benchmark categorized by grid size and required deductive steps. Evaluations reveal that frontier MLLMs fail on complex long-range dependencies (e.g., 9*9 puzzles). During post-training, this near-zero success rate causes severe reward sparsity, halting standard RLVR. We propose Adaptive Curriculum Group Relative Policy Optimization (AdaC-GRPO) to overcome this. Unlike rigid or prior-based schedules, AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" via online rollout accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that AdaC-GRPO enables Qwen2.5-VL-7B to approach the performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash while bridging 62.2% of the overall accuracy gap to Gemini-2.5-Pro, with its generalizability further validated across InternVL-3.5 and Qwen3-VL.
summaryZh: 本文针对大模型在长程多模态推理任务（如视觉数独）中的表现不足，引入了FG-Sudoku基准测试。研究发现现有前沿多模态大模型在处理复杂逻辑依赖时存在困难，且传统的强化学习方法因奖励稀疏而失效。为此，作者提出了自适应课程组相对策略优化（AdaC-GRPO），通过在线滚动准确率动态调整训练难度。实验表明，该方法使Qwen2.5-VL-7B在复杂任务上大幅缩小了与顶级模型的性能差距，并验证了其在多种模型架构上的通用性。

glossary.explanationZh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习，通过逻辑验证结果作为奖励信号。
指需要多步推理或长序列决策的复杂任务。
在复杂任务中，模型难以获得有效奖励信号的现象。
一种由易到难的训练策略，旨在提升模型学习效率。
组相对策略优化，一种无需价值函数的强化学习算法。
